summary.text: Kiral Mace is the Workers Party candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 26 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent David Martin (R) and Democrat Jenny Desch.
Mace was also the Workers Party candidate for South Carolina State Senate District 16 in 2024, receiving 20.7% of the vote against incumbent Michael Johnson (R).

paragraphs.text: According to Ballotpedia, Kiral Mace was born in Fort Mill, South Carolina, has worked in manufacturing and earned a bachelor's degree from Provident University in 2023.

Mace advanced from a Workers Party convention for South Carolina House of Representatives District 26 on March 16, 2024, but appears among the withdrawn or disqualified candidates in that year's general election.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Mace said the aim was to give the district a public servant who is not in the pocket of big business, and listed key messages of putting people ahead of corporations, health care for everyone and more community service facilities.
